headline: Earnings dip while AUM keeps compounding
summary_short: Blue Owl's Q2 2026 revenue was roughly flat y/y at $137.0M, but net income fell 34.6% to $11.4M and pretax income dropped 16.0% to $70.9M; the company held its quarterly dividend at $0.23/share and grew AUM to $319B.
summary_long: Revenue was little changed y/y at $137.0M while pretax income fell 16.0% to $70.9M and net income fell 34.6% to $11.4M; diluted EPS held at $0.02 despite a 4.9% higher weighted diluted share count. The press release states no reason for the earnings decline. Cash rose 43.7% y/y to $169.1M and long-term debt grew 17.6% to $3.81B, while shareholders' equity fell 15.1% to $2.00B. Blue Owl declared a $0.23/share quarterly dividend and reported AUM of $319B, a five-fold increase since its 2021 listing, which management attributed to investment performance and platform diversification. No forward guidance on revenue, earnings, or capital plans was given.
